script:
Zhang Xiaomei
When Zhang Xiaomei was five years old, her biological mother died. She never knew who her biological father was. Her mother always missed that person, staring at his photograph every day, and eventually died of lovesickness. Zhang Xiaomei hated him - why was he so heartless and unfeeling, abandoning his wife and daughter? Deep seeds of hatred were planted in her young heart.
After her mother died, Zhang Xiaomei was adopted by the kind-hearted Li Butler. When she followed Li Butler to the castle and first saw the castle lord Zhen Youcai, she immediately recognized him as her deeply hated enemy and biological father. But she was too small and weak to take revenge, so she could only silently endure.
Li Butler was an honest and kind person who treated Zhang Xiaomei very well. Having never felt fatherly love since childhood, Li Butler's love was the only harbor she could rely on amid endless hatred and difficult concealment.
Zhen Youcai had a biological son called Zhen Gongzi, an absolute spoiled rich kid who never showed her a kind face because she was a picked-up orphan. Although Zhen Youcai would severely scold Zhen Gongzi when he saw him bullying her, it didn't reduce Zhen Gongzi's discrimination against her at all. This made Zhang Xiaomei increasingly realize that these father and son were birds of a feather, completely inhuman.
Things changed more than ten years later. First, several new guests moved into the castle. According to Li Butler, they were Zhen Youcai's good friend Wang Writer, a mystery novelist, his son Wang Guoqing, and assistant Ding Assistant. Wang Guoqing was about the same age as Zhang Xiaomei, and he seemed much more refined than Zhen Gongzi, apparently inheriting his father's scholarly temperament. He took the initiative to talk with Zhang Xiaomei. This was Zhang Xiaomei's first contact with a peer friend, and such a cultured boy at that, which moved her heart. Before long, the two established a relationship.
One day, Wang Guoqing suddenly came to find her, pale-faced with vacant eyes, which greatly frightened Zhang Xiaomei. When she asked Wang Guoqing what was wrong, he stammered and couldn't get to the point, only suddenly saying that Zhen Youcai was not a good person and had corrupted his father Wang Writer. Zhang Xiaomei knew that although Wang Writer was very talented, he was a very strange person, so she didn't ask much. But Zhen Youcai's matter was what she cared about. She knew that the man before her would never betray her, so she decided to open her heart and confide to Wang Guoqing her feelings over all these years, telling him that Zhen Youcai was her enemy and she must avenge her mother. Having a common enemy made Zhang Xiaomei trust Wang Guoqing even more.
On November 25th, after their conversation, they agreed to kill Zhen Youcai together on December 5th to avenge her mother. But just after Wang Guoqing left, Li Butler pushed the door open and entered. Zhang Xiaomei was startled, afraid that Li Butler knew about her plan. She worried that the loyal Li Butler would tell Zhen Youcai. But Li Butler said nothing, just lovingly patted her head as usual, and after saying goodnight to each other, he returned to his room to rest.
[December 5th Evening]
Around 10:20 PM, Wang Guoqing and Zhang Xiaomei came to Zhen Youcai's room as agreed. The room was very dark. Wang Guoqing told Zhang Xiaomei to keep watch at the door and went in himself. Zhang Xiaomei waited for a while and heard quite a commotion from inside. After the noise stopped and some more time passed, Wang Guoqing hurriedly came out and pulled Zhang Xiaomei to leave quickly. But after not walking far, they suddenly heard footsteps behind them. Just as Wang Guoqing was about to go back and check, Zhang Xiaomei held him back, saying she was more familiar with the castle layout and should go look instead. Wang Guoqing told her to be careful and then quickly left.
Zhang Xiaomei returned to Zhen Youcai's door. Just as she was about to look around, she heard coughing from inside the room. Zhang Xiaomei gathered her courage and opened the door, slipping in under cover of darkness. When she approached Zhen Youcai, she saw him lying in bed with his eyes open looking at her, which nearly scared her soul away. But Zhen Youcai was very calm and said, "So it's you. You know everything?" Zhang Xiaomei tried to calm herself, gently nodded, and replied, "If you're talking about my mother's matter, I've always known." Zhen Youcai fell silent, then closed his eyes: "I brought this upon myself. Do it. I wronged her." Only then did Zhang Xiaomei understand that Zhen Youcai had long known her identity. But hatred had long taken root in her heart, and nothing could make her forgive him. She untied the silk scarf from her hair and placed it over Zhen Youcai's mouth and nose, pressing down hard with her hands until she finally confirmed that Zhen Youcai's heartbeat had stopped. Only then did she leave, at about 10:25 PM.
Returning to her room, she wrapped her mother's photograph - her mother's only memento that she never let go of - in the silk scarf she had used to strangle Zhen Youcai, hoping that Zhen Youcai could take good care of her mother in heaven.
